title: radiation.replica.manifest/1
description: Sanctioned replica contract (5300, review E2). ONLY the exact pairs listed here may be byte-identical duplicates; every other duplicate in the tree still fails check 11. Both sides are hash-bound: a changed active file with a stale archive twin FAILS rather than quietly becoming an allowed mismatch.

retrieval_rule.const: Only the active neuron regions (sensoryneurons/ · interneurons/ · motorneurons/) are ordinary working context; the _archive/ replicas are evidence/history and must never be loaded into an assistant context alongside their canonical twin.
